task.title: Harden search retrieval and cut off request document normal path
task.summary_zh: 補 retrieval rank/filter/access/citation contract，並把 request-document compatibility 移到 dev/test/deprecated 路徑；staging/prod 正常路徑只走 durable index。
acceptance: durable index is the only normal staging production query path
request document compatibility is dev test or explicitly deprecated only
ranking filters access control and citations are deterministic
BFF uses service-backed search client only
tests cover cutoff and compatibility quarantine
